scope: Dedicated LLVM and Clang compressed cache groups; compiler matrix unchanged. Full candidate CI run completed successfully.
limitations: Repository cache inventory alone does not measure a complete working set because entries can be evicted during execution. Baseline sizes were recovered from the completed run logs; all six candidate keys were present in the cache API at observation.

This comparison excludes other tool, Rust, GCC, package-manager, dependency/build, download, and Guix source caches. It also excludes the previous Dev Container LLVM installation embedded within its broad tools cache.

The baseline combines selected compatibility Clang with development LLVM in separate entries. The candidate separates those installations and shares the matching development LLVM cache across targets.
No compression level or supported compiler window changed for this hosted comparison.
